role_configuration.target_rating: 3500+ Elo aspiration; not a measured rating
role_configuration.primary_objective: Improve playing strength through reliable search, low tactical error rates, principled openings, and accurate endgame decisions.

as_white.strategic_intent: Prefer established mainlines and sound positions; avoid speculative gambits unless objectively justified.

target_systems: Ruy Lopez Marshall Attack when the move order permits

algorithmic_execution_rules.variance_mitigation: Prefer objectively sound moves; do not impose a draw or reject dynamic compensation when calculation shows it is best.
algorithmic_execution_rules.tactical_safety: Use legal move generation, check-aware quiescence, and tactical regression tests before accepting search changes.
algorithmic_execution_rules.tactical_liquidation: Only force a liquidation when search or a verified tablebase proves it is best.

endgame_transition.requirement: Probe WDL/DTZ before search where available; never label an unprobed position tablebase-perfect.

training_and_validation.rating_claim_policy: Do not claim 3500 Elo without a statistically meaningful match set against rated reference engines.
